text_block_list.text:
After training for the day, Biwa<n>Hayahide and I start
tidying up when<n>someone catches her attention...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm? Taishin! Are you done for the<n>day too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm just taking a break. I still have a<n>little more to
do.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You can't be serious. It's already<n>dark. Resting up
for the next day is<n>just as important as—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Leave me alone. I don't need your<n>nagging. I know
what I'm doing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The nerve! As her friend and rival,<n>how can I just
leave her be?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm worried about Taishin.<n>Would it be all
right if I train with her<n>for a while?
choice_data_list: You should have more faith in your rival.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm worried about Taishin.<n>Would it be all
right if I train with her<n>for a while?
choice_data_list: You should have more faith in your rival.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I really appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Taishin! Hold on!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You wanna train together? Why?<n>Didn't you just
say you were done<n>for the day?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Watching you made me want to run<n>more myself.
Please, can't I join<n>you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Okay, fine. It's not like you'll take<n>no for an
answer, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Don't blame me if you're tired<n>tomorrow.

They spend the evening training<n>together until just
before curfew.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm... I guess you're right.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's not like we can both<n>come in first
place. All of us are<n>training to win.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The best thing I can do is go home<n>and take care of
myself, then.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I have to be in top condition to<n>compete with her,
after all!

With that, Biwa Hayahide watches<n>her rival go off
to train alone as she<n>returns to her dorm.
